lock.priorExposure: Synthetic development and previously exposed Jogging1 only; no selected Tiger2/Box pixels, boxes or predictions opened before lock. Public source sequence attributes seen.
lock.evaluation: Source-only occlusion/return windows and external boxes plus separate AI visibility labels frozen before predictions. Score missingness, incorrect overlap, unsupported hidden output, admission contamination, bank benefit versus disabled control and costs. No outcome tuning.

records.name: Bird1
records.reason: rendered cloud disappearance and return; not real-world camera footage

sources.sourceReview: Source overviews at stride8 used to locate events; all384 selected original images inspected in detailed source-only crops. External boxes never came from tracker output. No fresh predictions before label freeze. Tiger2/Box/David3 retain visible remnants, so partial; rendered Bird1 has cloud disappearance and uncertain fade boundaries. No full out-of-frame return in real camera footage. Box shares a tabletop setting with previously seen Lemming but is a different target recording. Selection based on source visibility, not model outcomes.
limitations: AI source visibility without independent human adjudication.
No independent distractor boxes; zero confirmed switches cannot establish no switching.
Existing frozen association scorer breaks recovery episodes at uncertain labels; Bird1 delay across its uncertain reveal is unresolved.
Partial-cover camera tasks and rendered hidden task must be reported separately.

validation: Local checks passed: 252 distinct Java tests, 161 desktop checks, executable kernel integration, actual agency regression and isolated offline/package preparation. Six actual app runs match all 570 frozen tracker/filter samples. Independent host overlap and admission checks, numeric appearance export, exact original evidence and cold recheck after owned-Java termination pass.
